title: Shogo 2.0
intro: Shogo 2.0 introduces personal workspaces, a free space where your own AI companion works alongside you, and Hoshi 2.0, our new default model. Business and Enterprise plans now include unlimited workspaces for better organization. It also rolls up everything shipped since 1.12: a redesigned workspace, scheduled routines, new models, and a long list of reliability fixes.

highlights.title: Personal workspaces
highlights.description: Every account now gets a free personal space with an AI companion that works on your goals, routines, and notes.

highlights.title: Hoshi 2.0
highlights.description: Our new default model reasons before it acts, at the same price as Hoshi 1.0.

highlights.title: Scheduled routines
highlights.description: Ask your companion to run a task on a schedule, like a weekday morning digest, and it happens automatically.

highlights.title: A redesigned workspace
highlights.description: New navigation, a unified chat shell, and a fresh onboarding flow across web, desktop, and mobile.

highlights.title: Unlimited workspaces
highlights.description: Business and Enterprise plans include unlimited workspaces for better organization.

title: Shogo 1.12
intro: The 1.12 release brings a built-in code editor with AI chat, big improvements to publishing your apps, and a smoother billing and usage experience.

highlights.title: Local Shogo IDE
highlights.description: Edit your project in a full code editor with an AI chat that understands your files.

highlights.title: Publish apps from local
highlights.description: Publish an app directly from the desktop app in local mode.

highlights.title: Server-backed published apps
highlights.description: Run published apps with durable data, always-on servers, and password protection.

highlights.title: Tech stacks at project creation
highlights.description: Pick your stack when creating a project to get started faster.

highlights.title: Smoother billing and usage
highlights.description: Track usage and remaining credits with a unified, live-updating experience.
